profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Tebra
profile.summary:
Versatile and skilled engineering professional with passion for learning, authentic leadership, and teamwork 

Background Summary:
Earned Udacity Machine Learning Engineering Nano-Degree 
Self-motivated learning to equip with skills to utilize for future development endeavors 
Designed architectures of new applications applying best practices and design patterns 
Developed full stack of applications from the back-end database designs to the client web user interfaces 
Developed applications from minimal requirement descriptions to full implementation 
Served technical leadership to provide training and technical guidance for team members 

Skillsets: 
Big Data platform engineering using Snowflake, Hadoop, Spark and Airflow 
Machine Learning Engineering using SciKit-Learn, TensorFlow and Keras  
Full-stack engineering using Java, Python, C#, Go, Node, JavaScript and UI Frameworks (Angular, ReactJS, JQuery, Bootstrap and etc.) 
Micro-service architecture development 
Object-Oriented Design, UML, Design Patterns, Docker Containers, CI/CD and Agile SDLC

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Core Services
positions.description:
Designed and implemented meta-data driven data pipelines for ingestion of the relational data into the cloud-based data lake 
Successful and timely delivery of data ingestion pipeline that migrated data from 40K SQL database instances with 17M tables into Snowflake 
Designed and built the corporate big data platform on Apache Hadoop and Snowflake platforms utilizing Apache Spark, Airflow, Python and Docker 
Developed SaaS product features on Java-based micro-services 
Onboarded engineers and led them to deliver time-critical projects on schedule

positions.title: Sr. Application Developer, Full Stack
positions.description:
Architected and led the development of e-learning course authoring system using AngularJS, MVC and  RESTful services 
Designed and implemented the asynchronous parallel task processing system to execute audio  and video encoding, and publishing on distributed servers 
Developed feature enhancements, refactored the code for better reuse and maintenance on the system 
Trained team members for on boarding, new technology adoption and application architecture

positions.title: Manager, Software Enginering
positions.description:
Developed mobile application for iPhone and iPad using Objective C and XCode 
Led mobile application development projects on Android and iOS platform 
Led team of more than 10 software developers who work on multiple projects 
Provided the technical leadership in front and back end engineering teams that develops and maintains the high traffic, high volume public web applications in 3-tier architecture on ASP.Net and SQL server platform 
Managed task assignment for projects, production support and work orders for timely delivery in fast-paced environment with constantly shifting priorities and emergencies

positions.title: Managing Engineer, Core Products & Solutions
positions.description:
As principal engineer for the company's Software as a Service products and services, played key role in developing core products that are public websites and back-end web applications for institutional clients 
Served as the technical point for product and program management to meet the requirements from multiple clients 
Led engineering team to develop new product with technical design and the team leadership in the Agile SDLC development effort 
Designed the software release management solution to support different deployment schedules for multiple clients 
Designed database storage strategy to enhance the performance by partitioning the data 
Led the engineering team of up to 7 engineers to develop new products by providing training, design and knowledge support  
Advised business analysts on business requirement analysis and application design

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
Designed the company's new technology platform based on a layered architecture using ASP.NET and C# 
Set up the development infrastructure by implementing a source/version control system, development, build and release procedures, and coding standards 
Designed and developed ASP.Net based Content Management System and its Runtime Engine for managing content and serving multiple data-driven, highly customizable websites through object-oriented techniques 
Advised system engineers on system configuration and troubleshooting of system issues 
Extensive hands-on management on database systems with millions of rows and hundreds of tables in multiple databases and servers for production, QA and development environments including database schema design and database migration

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented various web applications such as campaign management system which manages bulk e-mail, printed mail and phone campaigns to targeted audiences with schedules, student course planners, event calendar, appointment management, financial aid calculators, scheduled task processor, application process design and management, data merge and reporting applications 
Designed and implemented DTS and SSIS packages to perform ETL processes to load data from FTP and other external data sources
